title: 用事件而非时间判定 Future 完成
expected_output:
未放开 gate 时已完成数: 1
未放开 gate 时挂起数: 2
放开 gate 后已完成数: 2
放开 gate 后挂起数: 0
全部结果: ['fast', 'slow', 'slow2']
无任务被丢弃: True
code:
import threading
import time
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, wait, FIRST_COMPLETED


# wait() 用「事件」而不是「时间」做判据，
# 因此结果确定：哪个 future 先被 set，哪个就先完成。

gate = threading.Event()
results = {}


def blocking(name, wait_for_gate):
    if wait_for_gate:
        gate.wait(timeout=5)
    results[name] = "done"
    return name


with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=3) as pool:
    f_fast = pool.submit(blocking, "fast", False)
    f_slow = pool.submit(blocking, "slow", True)
    f_slow2 = pool.submit(blocking, "slow2", True)

    # 立刻检查：fast 应已完成，两个 slow 仍在等 gate
    done, pending = wait([f_fast, f_slow, f_slow2], timeout=0)
    print("未放开 gate 时已完成数:", len(done))
    print("未放开 gate 时挂起数:", len(pending))

    gate.set()                                  # 放开闸门
    done2, pending2 = wait([f_slow, f_slow2], timeout=5)
    print("放开 gate 后已完成数:", len(done2))
    print("放开 gate 后挂起数:", len(pending2))

print("全部结果:", sorted(results))
print("无任务被丢弃:", len(results) == 3)
